target_customer: Affluent young professionals, tech employees and entrepreneurs underserved by traditional private banks; later community and regional banks as a B2B platform
problem: Young high earners lack access to private banking and wealth management, which are built for the already wealthy.
business_model: Consumer premium banking and wealth management subscription and fees, pivoted to B2B white-label banking platform in 2024

founders.name: Victor Santos
previous_startups: banQi (Brazilian neobank, acquired by Via Varejo in May 2020)

technical_complexity.rationale: Built on partner bank infrastructure with a digital front end and brokerage integrations; hard parts were compliance, banking partnerships and wealth products.

defensibility.rationale: Depended on partner banks for charter and brand differentiation rather than owned licenses or data.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents did not copy it directly, but Citizens launched its own private bank in 2023 and Onyx Private later closed consumer accounts in March 2024.

market_need_then: Young high earners with illiquid equity were poorly served by premium banks; the founders cited the group as overlooked, with no quantified spend data found.

branding.domain_note: Used onyxprivate.com, not an exact .com for the one word; fetch returned 503 in 2026.
branding.community_and_virality: TechCrunch and Refresh Miami coverage in 2023; no fan or merch evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: Premium name and a memorable tagline earned 2023 press, but Onyx is a common name shared with unrelated brands, and the consumer product closed in 2024.

pivots.from: B2C private bank for young professionals
pivots.to: B2B white-label platform for community banks, regional banks and credit unions
pivots.why: Founder told press the company was shifting away from the B2C model; denied regulatory problems drove it.

outcome_analysis: Onyx Private raised 4.1 million dollars in May 2023 to build a private bank for young high earners, then closed customer accounts in March 2024 to pivot to a B2B banking platform. The YC page later lists it as acquired, with a founder bio naming Citizens Bank. No deal date, price or confirming announcement was found, so how the company ended is partly unknown.
notes: Acquirer Citizens Bank rests on a single founder bio line on the YC page plus an aggregator (Extruct); no press release or deal date found, so the exit is low certainty. Aggregators label the 2023 round seed; amounts for any earlier round not found, so coverage is partial. No dated 2022 competitor sources found.
